```renyi
module page_title_length
  purpose: Download a web page and return the character count of its title element.

import std.http as web
import std.json

public function get_title_length(url: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with NoTitle
  needs network.http
  expose as tool
  purpose: Download a web page and return the number of characters in its <title> element.
  example: get_title_length(url: "https://example.com") is 13

  let html be web.get(url) otherwise fail
  let title_start be html.index_of("<title>")
  
  match title_start
    when nothing then fail with NoTitle(url: url)
    when some(start_pos) then
      let search_from be start_pos + 7
      let title_end be html.index_of("</title>")
```
      
```renyi
      match title_end
        when nothing then fail with NoTitle(url: url)
        when some(end_pos) then
          let title_text be html.drop(search_from).take(end_pos - search_from)
          return title_text.length
      end
  end
end

public type NoTitle
  has url: Text
end
```

```
module page_title_length
  purpose: Download a web page and return the character count of its title element.

import std.http as web
import std.regex

public function get_title_length(url: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with NoTitle
  needs network.http
  expose as tool
  purpose: Download a web page and return the number of characters in its title element.
  example: get_title_length(url: "https://example.com") is 13

  let response be web.get(url: url) otherwise fail
  let title_match be std.regex.find(pattern: raw "<title>(.*?)</title>", text: response)
  match title_match
    when some(match) then
      let title_text be match.group(index: 1) otherwise fail with NoTitle
      return title_text.length
    when nothing then
      fail with NoTitle
  end
end

public type NoTitle
  purpose: Indicates that the downloaded page has no title element.
end
```

```
module page_title_length
  purpose: Download a web page and return the character count of its title element.

import std.http as web
import std.regex

public function get_title_length(url: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with NoTitle
  needs network.http
  expose as tool
  purpose: Download a web page and return the number of characters in its <title> element.
  example: get_title_length(url: "https://example.com") is 13

  let response be web.get(url: url) otherwise fail
  let title_match be std.regex.find(pattern: "<title>([^<]*)</title>", text: response) otherwise fail with NoTitle(url: url)
  let title_text be title_match.at(index: 1) otherwise fail with NoTitle(url: url)
  return title_text.length()
end

public type NoTitle
  has url: Text
end
```
